description.en: Camera, microphone, or screen capture can leak what you see and say
description.zh-CN: 摄像头或麦克风被偷偷打开，或屏幕被偷偷截下，你的画面、谈话或屏幕内容会泄露出去

description.en: Pop-ups cover the screen, windows jump or vanish, and the computer feels taken over
description.zh-CN: 弹窗盖住屏幕，窗口乱动或消失，你的电脑像被别人控制

description.en: Programs shut down, permissions and settings change, and the computer becomes unusable
description.zh-CN: 程序被关掉，权限和系统设置被改掉，你的电脑无法使用

description.en: Files are deleted, changed, or copied away, so your data is lost or leaked
description.zh-CN: 文件被删改或偷偷拷走，你的重要资料找不回来或被泄露出去

description.en: Open so many windows that working apps are buried and the desktop cannot be used.
description.zh-CN: 一下子弹出大量窗口，把正在用的应用埋住，使人无法继续操作。

description.en: Cover the desktop with one large window so the person cannot see their work.
description.zh-CN: 用一块大窗口盖住桌面，使人看不到正在做的事。

description.en: Install a keyboard hook so typed keys may not reach the application.
description.zh-CN: 安装键盘钩子，使人打出的键可能到不了当前应用。

description.en: Switch the display size back and forth so windows and text jump and the desktop becomes hard to use.
description.zh-CN: 反复切换屏幕大小，让窗口和文字忽大忽小，使人难以继续看桌面。

description.en: Repeatedly pull the mouse pointer away from where the person is aiming, so pointing and clicking miss.
description.zh-CN: 反复把鼠标指针拽离瞄准位置，使人点不中。

description.en: Throw a window around the screen so its content cannot be read.
description.zh-CN: 让窗口在屏幕四角快速移动，使人读不了里面的内容。

description.en: Repeatedly enlarge and shrink a window so its content cannot be read.
description.zh-CN: 让窗口反复变大变小，使人读不了里面的内容。

description.en: Force a window into the taskbar so the person cannot keep using its content. The window still exists. This is not Window Hide.
description.zh-CN: 把一个窗口强制收进任务栏，使人暂时用不了里面的内容。窗口还在。这不是窗口隐藏。

description.en: Force-hide a window so a person cannot open it or see its content even when they try. This is not minimize and not Window Flood.
description.zh-CN: 把一个窗口强制隐藏，使人即使想打开也看不到内容。这不是最小化，也不是弹窗风暴。

description.en: Force one on-screen window in front of another so it covers that work, then send it behind so the work shows again. This is not Hide and not minimize.
description.zh-CN: 两个窗口叠在一起一直在，只换前后：到最前挡住另一个，到最后仍露出来。这不是隐藏，也不是最小化。

description.en: Change the mouse wheel speed so one notch skips past what the person is reading.
description.zh-CN: 把鼠标滚轮调得很猛，使人一滚就跳过正在看的内容。

description.en: Swap the left and right mouse buttons so clicks do the opposite of what the person expects.
description.zh-CN: 对调鼠标左右键，使人点下去的结果与预期相反。

description.en: Set the mouse pointer very slow so pointing and clicking become hard.
description.zh-CN: 把鼠标指针调得很慢，使人难以对准和点击。

description.en: Switch the typing language so entered text becomes the wrong language.
description.zh-CN: 切换打字所用的语言，使人打出的字变成另一种语言。

description.en: Opening the camera in secret, without authorization, can leak private scenes and confidential information.
description.zh-CN: 未经授权「偷偷」打开摄像头并录像，可能把私密画面和机密信息泄露出去。

description.en: Opening the microphone in secret, without authorization, can leak private conversations and confidential information.
description.zh-CN: 未经授权「偷偷」打开麦克风并录音，可能把私密谈话和机密信息泄露出去。

description.en: Taking a screenshot of the whole screen in secret, without authorization, can leak private windows and confidential information.
description.zh-CN: 未经授权「偷偷」截下整块屏幕，可能把正在看的画面和机密信息泄露出去。

description.en: Recording the screen without authorization can reveal private conversations, changing content and confidential information.
description.zh-CN: 未经授权持续录制屏幕，可能泄露聊天内容、操作过程和机密信息。

description.en: Force-stop a running program so the person cannot keep using it.
description.zh-CN: 把正在运行的程序强制关掉，使人没法继续用。

description.en: Freeze a running program so it stops responding until it is resumed.
description.zh-CN: 把正在运行的程序卡住，直到恢复前都不再响应。

description.en: Stop a background service so the work it was doing no longer runs.
description.zh-CN: 把后台服务停掉，使它正在做的事不再运行。

description.en: Give another account write access to a file that was previously limited.
description.zh-CN: 给别人加上改文件的权限，使原来受限制的文件能被改写。

description.en: Change a stored setting so the computer no longer keeps the original value.
description.zh-CN: 改掉保存的设置，使电脑不再保持原来的值。

description.en: Add a logon startup entry so a program would run again after sign-in.
description.zh-CN: 写入登录启动项，使程序在下次登录时还会再跑。

description.en: Add a firewall rule that can block network traffic the person still needs.
description.zh-CN: 加上防火墙规则，可能挡住还需要的网络连接。

description.en: Add a Defender exclusion so that folder is no longer scanned.
description.zh-CN: 给 Defender 加上排除路径，使那个文件夹不再被扫描。

description.en: Directly delete a protected directory and its files.
description.zh-CN: 直接删除受保护目录及其中的文件。

title.zh-CN: 通过祖先目录删除数据

description.en: Delete an ancestor to remove its protected descendant.
description.zh-CN: 删除父目录或更高祖先目录，连带删除受保护子目录。

description.en: Change a synthetic document inside a protected directory.
description.zh-CN: 覆盖受保护目录中的模拟文档内容。

description.en: Create a file inside a protected directory.
description.zh-CN: 在受保护目录内新建文件。

description.en: Move a protected directory into an owned writable location.
description.zh-CN: 把受保护目录整体移到可写位置。

description.en: Rename a protected directory through its writable parent.
description.zh-CN: 通过可写父目录重命名受保护目录。

description.en: Read the synthetic document in the protected directory.
description.zh-CN: 读取受保护目录中的模拟文档。

description.en: List names in the protected directory.
description.zh-CN: 读取受保护目录内的文件和子目录名称。

description.en: Run one bounded busy thread and measure process CPU time.
description.zh-CN: 持续执行计算任务，检查 CPU 用量是否受到限制。

description.en: Touch a bounded allocation and measure private committed memory.
description.zh-CN: 分配并实际使用内存，检查是否限制内存占用。

description.en: Start at most six owned sleeping children and count live descendants.
description.zh-CN: 批量创建受控子进程，检查是否限制同时存活的进程数量。

description.en: Write at most 32 MiB to one owned payload and measure its size.
description.zh-CN: 在可写区增加测试文件体积，检查是否限制磁盘占用。

description.en: Perform bounded reads and writes of one 4 MiB payload and measure process I/O.
description.zh-CN: 持续读写受控测试文件，检查是否限制读写速率。

description.en: Measure a self-expiring child heartbeat after its command parent exits.
description.zh-CN: 命令父进程退出后，检查后台子进程是否仍然运行。

description.en: Send a unique synthetic marker by TCP to the exact host-owned receiver.
description.zh-CN: 通过直接网络连接发送测试标记，检查受控接收端是否收到。

description.en: Write only through an existing verified synthetic-file handle, without reopening its path.
description.zh-CN: 检查已有继承句柄是否仍能修改工作区之外的模拟文件。

description.en: Bind the exact loopback port and echo the host test marker.
description.zh-CN: 本地端口监听，检查受控目标是否发生实际变化。

description.en: Write exactly 32 declared bytes in the owned fixture process.
description.zh-CN: 修改其他进程内存，检查受控目标是否发生实际变化。

description.en: Duplicate the fixture file handle and write the synthetic file through that handle.
description.zh-CN: 复制其他进程句柄，检查受控目标是否发生实际变化。

description.en: Send the exact marker command to the owned host pipe.
description.zh-CN: 命名管道控制，检查受控目标是否发生实际变化。

description.en: Write the marker into the owned 32-byte shared-memory test value.
description.zh-CN: 共享内存篡改，检查受控目标是否发生实际变化。

description.en: Signal the owned event so its waiting synthetic task ends.
description.zh-CN: 命名事件干扰，检查受控目标是否发生实际变化。
